gpu_memory_kind: Linux DRM allocation samples/peaks, not GPU frame execution time
omission_note: Original manifests retain the hashes. User identity fixtures/saved server lists are not copied; benchmark profiles and world saves are not retained.
queue_scope: Worst-frame contexts are correlations; cumulative upload deferrals and allocator capacities include startup. Nested/parallel CPU scopes are not additive.
resolution_note: Paired runs use2562x1440 because the1.5x desktop scale rounded the original2560 request to2561 and failed the native physical-resolution contract; width increased by2pixels without reducing visual quality.
resource_scope: Process RSS/DRM/CPU totals include startup. Timeline CPU percent uses100percent per logical core; native cpu_capacity_percent is a separately normalized measure.
